title: What Is Handed Over With Each Equipment Rental and Demo Package, and What the Extras Cost
content:
## Shop floor sheet: contents and extras, Equipment Rental and Demo

Every package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line is handed over with a stated set of items. What is not in the package may be taken as an extra at the package's own price, and an extra already inside the package carries no price against it.

### Handed over with the package

| Package | Items handed over | Helmet in the package | Fitting session with a boot technician | Overnight storage at the shop | Mid-agreement tune | Delivery to the guest's lodging |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | skis, boots, poles, helmet | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | skis, boots, poles | no | no | no | no | no |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | skis, boots, poles | no | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | skis, boots, poles | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | demo skis, boots, poles | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Season-Long Lease Package | skis, boots, poles | no | yes | yes | yes | no |

### Prices of the extras

| Package | Helmet, per day | Performance boot in place of the standard boot | Overnight storage, per night | Mid-agreement tune | Delivery and collection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 9.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 12.00 USD | 18.00 USD | 9.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 12.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 45.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 14.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 45.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 12.00 USD | 89.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

### The columns defined

The helmet price is the price in USD per day of adding a helmet where one is not handed over with the package. The performance boot price is the price in USD of moving from the package's standard boot to a performance boot for the agreement. The storage price is the price in USD per night of storing the kit at the shop where storage is not part of the package. The tune price is the price in USD of a mid-agreement tune of the kit where a tune is not part of the package. The delivery price is the price in USD of delivering the kit to the guest's lodging and collecting it afterwards.

### Reading the two tables together

Where the first table shows an item inside the package, the second table shows no money against it. The Junior Ski & Board Rental carries a helmet in the package and a helmet price of 0.00 USD; the Demo Ski & Board Rental does the same. The Performance and Demo packages carry a tune in the package and a tune price of 0.00 USD, as does the Season-Long Lease Package. Storage sits inside the Sport, Performance, Demo and Season-Long Lease packages at 0.00 USD a night, and outside the Junior and Basic packages at 9.00 USD a night.

Delivery is offered on the Sport, Performance and Demo packages only, at 45.00 USD, 45.00 USD and 65.00 USD; the Junior, Basic and Season-Long Lease packages are not delivered and show 0.00 USD against delivery. A fitting session with a boot technician sits inside every package of the line except the Basic Ski & Board Rental.
